steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: This topic covers key vocabulary and structures for question forms and modal verbs. You need to know the topic vocabulary, be able to use it in all four skills (listening, speaking, reading, writing), and express opinions with reasons. | GCSE Spanish Exam Tips: Spanish questions use inverted question marks (¿...?). Question words (qué, quién, cuándo, dónde, cómo, por qué, cuánto). Modal verbs: poder (can), deber (must/should), querer (want), saber (know how to). Use modal + infinitive structure.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Write 4 sentences in Spanish about question forms and modal verbs. | Write a paragraph (40-60 words) giving your opinion on question forms and modal verbs. | Translate into Spanish: "I think question forms and modal verbs is important because..."
